notes.title: Anniversary
notes.content:
Bugvasion TD was released a year ago and we as a team are really proud of it, we’ve achieved what we wanted: to release a decent and fun game and Bugvasion TD did just that for us.

To celebrate the one year anniversary we are putting a 70% discount on the game for a week, so anybody who is still interested can pick it up with a huge discount. 

We had a lot of plans for the game after release, the main thing being a free DLC with new levels and game mechanics - which we’ve partly managed to do in our Supercharged update adding a lot of new things last summer. However after this point it’s not feasible for us to invest anymore time and energy into Bugvasion TD, we wanted to get the clear picture for our players - what you buy is what you get - at least for now.

We are full of plans, other gaming projects are in the works - we should be able to announce our next “big thing” in the upcoming months.

Thank you for coming with us on this journey and supporting us, we hope you enjoyed our little quirky tower defence game, we will be back and we”ll keep you posted!

Cheers,
Demeter, Head of Development

notes.title: Bugvasion TD on Linux!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Gamers,

Bugvasion TD has been out for more than 6 months and from the very beginning we wanted to port our game to Linux. Since it was made in Unity it seemed quite an easy task but we had to realize that in order for it to work properly we had to optimize the game a lot more. 

Since the release we have updated the game more than 15 times including a major "Supercharged" update released in June which added a lot of new content, new gameplay mechanics and so on.

Now we are proud to present a much better version of Bugvasion TD for the Linux gamers out there!

We have a lot more plans with the game, keep an eye out on updates and announcements!

Cheers,
Demeter / IR
Head of Development

notes.title: The Supercharged Update is live!
notes.content:
“Bugvasion TD was released back in February on Steam and while it was a cute looking game we had to realize that we’ve focused too much on the visuals and not enough on the actual gameplay experience. We’ve decided to put another 4 months full time development into the game and build upon the existing base. The update adds new gameplay mechanics that change the whole experience adding excitement, variety and a lot of much needed fun.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/3a7ad5c659a1e4eec3ee074bb8042521b9b1f855.jpg[/img]

[b]Here what’s new:[/b]

[b]The Supercharging mechanic[/b] makes using the special attacks a much more rewarding and strategic experience, you can now reload each attack up to 6 times. Chain together several attacks and bring devastation to the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/8e505429b473d54bad3ede7e7f8e0a820a39f248.gif[/img]

[b]The Event System[/b] brings randomized waves with different features, you’ll never know what comes next, it can be helpful or it can put you in disadvantage, it all comes down to luck.

[b]The Reaction System [/b]is there to compliment you for doing stunts like killing a certain amount of enemies at once or using a supercharged special attack among many other things. The reaction can be a funny animation or a one liner from our heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/dc2d8289de81995e0e55fe1fc14c55719c419d91.jpg[/img]

[b]Now you can earn points, unlock badges and Steam Achievements. [/b]The new Bug Report Screen will tell you all you need to know about the match you’ve just played and you compete with others on who gets the highest score.

[b]The tutorial has been expanded, new music [/b]was added and several previous issues have been ironed out.

[b]Chinese language support [/b]was also added!

“We really think we’ve nailed the fun and rewarding experience this time and made Bugvasion TD a casual strategy game worth playing”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/6ec5429782de05df973426db7820f08125360e48.jpg[/img]

We are still planning to release a free DLC with new maps in the coming month among many other things.

The future of Bugvasion TD:
- free DLC with new levels, enemies and towers
- seasonal updates
- more languages
- porting to Linux, Mac OS and consoles

The new update adds new gameplay mechanics which basically makes Bugvasion TD a lot more fun and rewarding experience.

Cheers!
Demeter, Director

[b]- Reactions [/b]- there is a ton of reactions ranging from simple voice lines to fully animated characters appearing on the screen and reacting to the player’s actions 
[b]- Bug report screen[/b] - now after each level you can see detailed statistics on how many bugs you have killed and what you have achieved
[b]- High Scores[/b] - Now you get points for each kill, each special attack and combo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/3d35fc76133a7a18ea38875ec70cb1c4cfa1ff9e.gif[/img]

[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/73c049b47bb30dff3c01658e1eb48f8e7813682e.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Supercharged update is due to release in early May!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Bugvasion TD was released on the 17th of February and while most reviewers liked the theme and visuals of the game, the gameplay itself was only mediocre. 

We had to re-think and re-evaluate our goals and the direction of the game. We knew that we have something appealing but not fun enough so we’ve decided to overhaul the gameplay and add a lot of new mechanics - basically build upon the foundation and make Bugvasion TD a game worth playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/79333602eccce931d3005b1434a69604fb693608.gif[/img]

We call it “The Supercharged” update and it will bring a lot of new things to the table, here is a brief list of the additions you can expect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/ffc8fcf8c5e20552f8e791a45506ca9d7551e210.png[/img]

[b]* Supercharging [/b]-  All the special attacks are going to be super-chargeable several times to make them a lot stronger and there will a ton of new animations complimenting this new gameplay mechanic
[b]* Complete score, combo and badge system[/b] - now you will be able to see statistics on your matches, earn badges and points
[b]* Events [/b]- On every level there will be special waves where the conditions of the game change, some will make it harder, some will make it easier to win and it’s completely random  which ones you activate
[b]* Reactions[/b] - The characters in the game will react to your actions with voice over or animation
[b]* New music[/b] - we have changed the score completely to compliment the new mechanics and visuals
[b]* Steam achievements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/4757a62adc0813dc26401c6791d826472a4a834e.gif[/img]

On the top of these there will be a ton of other small additions, QOL changes and optimization.

We truly believe that this update will change the game and bring our players a new experience!

For the next few weeks - until the release of The Supercharged update - we won't be updating the current version of the game, however we will add a public experimental branch as soon as the update is in playable shape.

We will keep you posted on our progress!

Cheers,
Demeter / IR
Head of Development

notes.title: The next big update
notes.content:
[b]Bugvasion TD released a month ago![/b]

We are so proud that our first game, Bugvasion TD is out for a month on Steam now with only positive reviews. However the last month also made us realize that despite getting a lot of positive feedback on how the game looks the gameplay is not on par with the visuals - so we have been actively working on new gameplay mechanics, events and a lot of cool additions that will make the game much smoother and fun to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/3da58fa78516c27131d9e98b7839c3eaf5da41ff.jpg[/img]

[b]What happened so far since the release:[/b]
We have been listening to our players, fixing, tweaking and adding new things. Here is a brief list:
- Added Russian, French and Hungarian localizations
- Added speed up button
- Quality of life changes
- Gameplay balancing fixes
- Lot of bug fixes and optimizations 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/eb8c0da8c42d385f8b415a7cd850a55c25a39eb6.jpg[/img]
Supercharging is a go!

[b]Our plans for the next major “Supercharged” update, coming in 6-8 weeks:[/b]
We are working on a major update that will add a lot of new things to Bugvasion TD, such as:
- Events - a new gameplay mechanic - certain waves will behave differently and the player will have to adapt their defense according to the situation
- Supercharging - a new gameplay mechanic - all the special attacks are going to be super-chargeable several times to make them a lot stronger
- Tactical view - added planning phase before every wave
- Visual upgrade of the towers
- New animations, updated cutscenes
- New music 
- Achievements 
- Post match screen with detailed stats
- Tutorial
- A lot more quality of life changes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/c9740ec33d71fc87dc558a797aab9211e0b0d0d2.png[/img]
Some of the redesigned towers.

[b]Porting:[/b]
We have pushed the Linux and MacOS ports back a couple of months so we can make the game better and more fun. We are also working on several console ports but those are also only going to happen once our “Supercharged” major update is released, so every player can get the best version of Bugvasion TD.

We still have a long way ahead of us but we are looking forward to every step.

[i]Cheers,
Demeter, Head of Development[/i]

notes.title: Bugvasion TD is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/f57ed516a444a2f7cfa2de391ccc17710543b1ac.jpg[/img]

After two long years of work we are finally here, releasing our very first game on Steam for PC. This is a dream come true for all of us and we are looking forward to hearing the players’ opinions. However our journey is not over yet, Bugvasion TD’s version number might have hit 1.0 but that doesn’t mean that we will stop working on it, we have many things planned for this year, we’ve put together a roadmap so you can see what’s coming:

[b]Short term plans (within 1-2 months):[/b]
Bug fixing and fine tuning - Listening to our players is one of the most important thing for us, we want you to enjoy the game and we are ready to listen to your suggestions and try to implement them in Bugvasion TD
Localization - we want to make Bugvasion TD accessible to as many players as possible by translating the game into various languages, Hungarian, Portuguese, French and Russian versions are almost finished and many more are in the works
Steam Achievements - We wanted to include this in version 1.0 but we had to postpone it, luckily not by much, they should be in the game within a few weeks
Steam Remote Play - Adding this feature will allow players to play Bugvasion TD on their phone, tablet, TV or other PC.

[b]Long term plans (within 4-8 months):[/b]
Porting to Linux and Mac
Adding more levels as a free dlc: our plan is to scale up the Bugvasion universe by taking the players to space to fight the aliens on their mothership, 4 additional maps are planned as well as new special attacks and enemies
Seasonal events: for every holiday or celebration we are planning to add something fun to the game, it might be a new special attack with a seasonal theme or just a new background for the main menu, our main goal is to make coming back to the game worth it with new content every few weeks or so

We have a lot more things planned but so far we want to focus on the things we know we can manage in the given time-frame. This is our debut game so we still have a lot to learn, but we are ready to learn it with the players and for the players.

[b]Warning! If you had the demo or beta version installed there might be old saves files left even if you uninstalled it from your system, resetting the save game slots in-game will resolve any issues these save files would cause.
[/b]
If you have any suggestions, ideas that would make the game better, don't hold back, get in touch with, we would love to hear what you think!

Cheers!
[i]Demeter
Director of Bugvasion TD[/i]

notes.title: A message from the developers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/30ff161b8a283fa39d3dcb75879631ee970bae20.jpg[/img]

Bugvasion TD is releasing in 10 days and boy we are excited. The levels were already done by last summer so we spent the last 6-8 months to further develop the gameplay side of things implementing new interesting mechanics, adding a skill tree system, refining the UI and developing a funny story around the quirky gameplay.

The gameplay changed a lot during development, it started out as a classic tower defense game where you have to build and upgrade towers in a strategic manner to overcome the ever growing hordes of possessed bugs. Slowly we added a few special attacks and shifted the gameplay so the player has to use both towers and special attacks in order to defeat the enemy, but we didn’t stop there. Special abilities were the next thing, these are passive helpers and only really work together with other tools, they don’t damage the enemy by themselves.

Combining tools in a creative way was the next step. Now if you use the Rolling Death special attack, light it up with a Magny Tower and roll it over puddles of gas placed by the Gas Drop special ability you can light up half the map and seriously hurt the enemy. Now there are more of these combinations in the game, but we want the players to find them and use them to their advantage.

Finally we’ve added quite a few static defenses like glue tubes or PEZ dispensers, these are a part of the level designs, their use is limited but if the player uses them strategically they can be a big help in the fight.

After release we are planning to do localization first, Portuguese, Russian, Hungarian and Deutsch language versions are already in the works but we won’t stop there, there are many more languages planned.

We also want to bring the Bugvasion TD experience to other platforms, we will keep you updated once we have an ETA on any of the ports.

Just a few more days and Bugvasion TD is out, we can’t wait for you to play it!

Demeter, Head of Development, FSG

notes.title: Bugvasion TD - Play to Defend
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/12ec59291a9619860e8095926939c2c3c3c1a394.jpg[/img]
[i]I was a big fan of Micro Machines on Sega Genesis back in the day and I always wanted to adapt that art style to a different genre, so here is Bugvasion TD, a tower defense game where you have to protect your house room by room from alien possessed bugs. Our strongest asset as a team are visuals, our goal was to make a game that not only looks good but feels good as well, and it’s also a lot of fun to play. We don’t want to change the world, we just want the player to be able to escape reality for a few hours by playing our game.
[/i]
[b]Demeter Lorant, Concept, Head of Development[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/4fa99b4cc849aa427d0a273180e7987c901e33fb.png[/img]
[b]WHAT IS BUGVASION TD?[/b]
BVTD is a classic tower defense game where alien possessed bugs are attacking your house. You have to defend it room by room with the use of handmade defense towers, home made bug repellents and insect crushers. There is a ton of unlockable special attacks and abilities for you utilize, defend your home today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/69c87998cfe0245f224ce00b71ecc21b4f571ddd.png[/img]
[b]WHAT'S IN THE DEMO?[/b]
You can try out 5 levels across 3 rooms, test out 6 towers, 6 special attacks and 2 abilities, fight one very big boss and be happy once you've put them all in their place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/d436522f0d02d6d6643fe4da6d5041d86c118fae.png[/img]
[b]WHAT'S GOING TO BE IN THE FULL VERSION?[/b]
20+ colorful and deadly levels
15+ crawling, creeping, flying, slithering, wriggling enemies
12+ wacky and devastating special attacks
10+ upgradeable shooting, zapping, blasting, burning, poisoning towers
Unlockable skill and tech tree
Classic tower defense experience with a lot of fun
